thread:
maria: Heads-up: Q3 hosted capacity planning kickoff. Need decision on +100-200 GPUs (mix buy vs 12mo leases) to cover projected runway. Quick sync? TL;DR: projected 35% token throughput growth in Jul-Aug, 2.5x peak traffic on promo days.

liam: Can you drop the forecast numbers and assumptions? which regions are we sizing for — NA/EU/APAC split?

maria: Assumptions: baseline 1.2M tokens/min sustained, current fleet = 420 A100-equivalent (weighted). Forecast peak tokens/min -> 1.62M (35% growth). Regional split: NA 60%, EU 25%, APAC 15%. Need buffer to hit 99.9% latency SLOs during promo + cross-region failover.

nikita: How many GPU hours/day does that translate to? Also FYI spot availability in APAC is thin right now — leasing might be the only fast option there.

beth: Quick rough calc — if we target ~60% utilization to keep latency headroom, needed GPU equiv = ceil((peak_tokens_per_min / tokens_per_gpu_per_min) * safety_factor). Example quick math: ```bash # rough math baseline_tokens_per_gpu=3500 peak=1620000 safety=1.25 echo $(( (peak / baseline_tokens_per_gpu) * safety )) ``` That gives ballpark ~579 GPUs.

kevin: We have 420 today, so delta ~160 GPUs. Procurement tradeoffs: buy = lower unit cost but lead time & capex; 12mo lease = ~20% premium vs buy but much faster and flexible. Spot/leased blend could be 80 buy + 80 lease.

liam: Lead times: GPUs on order are ~8-12w, racks & NVLink passives ~6w. For managed leases we can provision in 2-3w depending on partner and shipping. If we need runway for July promos we should action leases asap.

ops-bot: Reminder: previous mid-May deployment caused network congestion in us-west during peak. If we expand in us-west we should reserve cross-AZ trunk bandwidth before capacity goes live.

maria: Proposal (high level): tranche plan — immediate 80-100 leased GPUs for quick runway + procure 80-100 buys to arrive mid-Q3. Also reserve ~20% of added capacity in EU as leased to meet data residency + failover SLA.

nikita: Cost sanity check: rough monthly cost for 100 leased GPUs = ~$180k-220k/mo depending on vendor. Buy 100 amortized over 36 months reduces monthly burden but increases capital outlay now. Need finance to run amortization and unit-token cost comparison.

beth: I'll run exact scenarios with pricing deck and expected utilization. Also recommend testing mixed routing: send 10-15% traffic to quantized small variants during peak — can lower tokens/GPU by ~20-30% and reduce delta GPUs needed.

kevin: Operational checklist if we approve tranches: i) network path validation ii) PDU/power & rack space confirmed iii) cross-AZ trunk reserved iv) node images & k3s config tested v) monitoring dashboards pre-provisioned. I'll open facilities + infra reqs today.

maria: Can we meet for 30m tomorrow 10:00am to lock the tranche plan? I'll send invite + short prep doc with numbers. :calendar:

liam: Yes, add finance + procurement pls — @beth @kevin

beth: :+1: I'll prep cost scenarios (buy vs 12mo lease vs lease+spot mix) and include per-token unit economics and a 90/95/99 latency SLO cost table.
